business.name: Twist Studio
business.headline: Ideas with a bit of bend.
business.intro: A small design studio in Collingwood. Brand identities, websites and packaging for businesses that would rather not look like everyone else.
business.disclaimer: Sample site made by Oceanalt. Not a real design studio.

hero.photoAlt: Glossy lavender and pink 3D loops tied in a knot

credentials.text: A fixed fee for every project
You work with the designer, not an account manager

servicesIntro: Most of our clients are cafés, shops and small brands in Melbourne. We take on four projects at a time, so each one gets our full attention.

services.name: Brand identity
services.desc: Name check, logo, colours, type and a one-page guide your printer will understand.

services.name: Website design
services.desc: Designed, written with you and built to load fast on a phone.

services.name: Packaging and print
services.desc: Labels, boxes, menus and signage, set up for your printer.

feesIntro: Every project has a fixed fee, agreed in writing before we start. Two rounds of changes are included at each stage.

fees.note: Half a day, comes off your project fee
For brands that just need tidying

process.title: A workshop
process.desc: Half a day on who you're for, what you sell and what you're sick of looking like.

process.title: Two directions
process.desc: Two different routes, shown on real things: your sign, your cup, your homepage.

process.title: The finished kit
process.desc: Every file, a short guide and a call with your printer if you want one.

faq.q: How long does a brand take?
faq.a: About six weeks from the workshop to the finished files.

faq.q: Do you work with businesses outside Melbourne?
faq.a: Yes. The workshop can be on a video call.
You do, once the final invoice is paid. We'll ask before showing it in our portfolio.

contactIntro: Tell us what you're making. We reply within a business day.
